title: Algebra 1: Foundations to Quadratics
subject: Algebra 1
description: A full-year Algebra 1 sequence, foundations to quadratics, with a real-world project at every step.

milestones.title: Number sense and operations
milestones.description: Integers, fractions, decimals, order of operations — the tools everything else is built on.
milestones.projectIdea: Personal budget spreadsheet: track real (or imagined) income and expenses for two weeks using signed numbers.

milestones.title: Variables and expressions
milestones.description: Translating words into symbols and evaluating expressions.
milestones.projectIdea: Write your own 'word problem translator' cheat sheet with 10 real-life examples from your home.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: Algebra basics — variables and expressions

milestones.title: Solving one-step and two-step equations
milestones.description: The balance method; solving for x with confidence.
milestones.projectIdea: Design a puzzle trail around your house where each clue is a two-step equation.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: One-step and two-step equations

milestones.title: Multi-step equations and variables on both sides
milestones.description: Distribution, combining like terms, and equations that fight back.
milestones.projectIdea: Error-analysis poster: find and fix five planted mistakes in worked equations.

milestones.title: Inequalities
milestones.description: Solving and graphing inequalities; when the sign flips.
milestones.projectIdea: Set personal fitness or reading goals as inequalities and track them for a week.

milestones.title: Ratios, rates, and proportions
milestones.description: Unit rates, scale, and proportional reasoning.
milestones.projectIdea: Scale drawing of your bedroom or a fantasy map at 1:50 scale.

milestones.title: Percents and real-world applications
milestones.description: Discounts, interest, tips, and percent change.
milestones.projectIdea: Plan a shopping trip: calculate discounts, tax, and compare unit prices to find the real best deal.

milestones.title: Introduction to functions
milestones.description: What a function is, function notation, domain and range.
milestones.projectIdea: Machine metaphor poster: build three 'function machines' from cardboard with input-output rules.

milestones.title: Linear functions and graphing
milestones.description: Slope, intercepts, and the stories lines tell.
milestones.projectIdea: Track something daily for a week (temperature, screen time) and graph it — find the slope of your life.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: Linear equations and graphs

milestones.title: Systems of equations
milestones.description: Solving systems by graphing, substitution, and elimination.
milestones.projectIdea: Party planning on a budget: two constraints, one solution — show it three ways.

milestones.title: Exponents and scientific notation
milestones.description: Exponent rules and describing very big and very small things.
milestones.projectIdea: Scale the solar system: express real astronomical distances in scientific notation and build a sidewalk model.

milestones.title: Polynomials
milestones.projectIdea: Algebra tiles from paper: build and photograph each operation.

milestones.title: Factoring
milestones.description: Common factors, trinomials, and special products.
milestones.projectIdea: Factoring relay: a game deck where matching trinomials to their factors wins the round.

milestones.title: Quadratic equations
milestones.description: Solving quadratics by factoring, square roots, and the quadratic formula.
milestones.projectIdea: Projectile experiment: throw a ball, film it, and model its height with a quadratic.

milestones.title: Radicals and rational expressions
milestones.description: Simplifying radicals and working with rational expressions.
milestones.projectIdea: Design a mini golf hole and calculate exact diagonal distances using radicals.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: Radicals and rational exponents

milestones.title: Data and statistics
milestones.description: Lines of best fit, scatter plots, and interpreting data honestly.
milestones.projectIdea: Conduct a family or co-op survey and present findings with a scatter plot and trend line.

milestones.title: Exponential growth and decay
milestones.description: Growth models, decay, and compound interest.
milestones.projectIdea: The paper-folding challenge: model exponential growth, then calculate when the stack reaches the moon.
milestones.resourceHint: Khan Academy: Exponential growth and decay

milestones.title: Capstone: Algebra in the wild
milestones.description: A self-designed project that uses at least four skills from the year.
milestones.projectIdea: Choose your own: plan a business, design a game economy, or analyze a sport — prove Algebra 1 lives in it.
